# swift-argument-parser

Apple's [Swift Argument Parser](https://github.com/apple/swift-argument-parser), used by the `hostshift` command-line tool.

- Version: 1.8.2
- Commit: `6a52f3251125d74daf04fcbd5e6f08a75d074382`
- Licence: Apache License 2.0 with Runtime Library Exception, see [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt)

Only the Swift sources of the `ArgumentParser` and `ArgumentParserToolInfo` modules are vendored, unmodified. To update, replace `Sources` with the same two folders from a newer release tag, then update the version and commit above.
